error.need-x-reputation-to-mention: You need at least %1 reputation for mentioning chatgpt
no-permission-to-chat: Sorry, you do not have permission to chat with me.
admin.api-key-help: Get your API Key and enter it above. You can enter a Google Gemini API key if you want to use Google Gemini. Don't forget to change the model used to a gemini variant. Requires a restart.
admin.api-base-url-help: If you want to use Google's Gemini API, enter the base URL here (https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai/). Otherwise, leave it blank to use OpenAI's API. Requires a restart.
admin.chatgpt-username-help: and enter their username. Other users can mention this user to ask questions to ChatGPT or send private messages if enabled below.
admin.enable-private-messages-help: If enabled, users can send the ChatGPT user private messages.
admin.mention-settings-help: Override API settings specifically for @mention responses. If left blank, the general API key and base URL above are used. Requires a restart.
admin.mention-api-key-help: API key to use for @mention responses. Leave blank to use the general API key above.
admin.mention-api-base-url-help: API base URL to use for @mention responses. Leave blank to use the general API base URL above.
admin.summary-system-prompt-placeholder: You summarize discussion forum threads into concise summaries.
admin.summary-system-prompt-help: System prompt used when summarizing each chunk of a topic. Leave blank to use the default. You can write this in any language (e.g. Hebrew) to control the summary's language and style.
admin.summary-final-system-prompt-placeh: You are an assistant that summarizes forum thread summaries into a single cohesive summary.
admin.summary-final-system-prompt-help: System prompt used to merge multiple chunk-summaries into a single final summary (only triggered for long topics). Leave blank to use the default.
admin.summary-render-markdown-help: If enabled, the summary dialog will render Markdown (bold, lists, headings, etc.). If disabled, the summary is shown as plain text.
admin.restrictions-help: General restrictions that apply to all features (mentions and topic summaries) unless overridden below.
admin.minimum-reputation-help: Minimum reputation required to use any OpenAI feature. (0 to disable)
admin.allowed-groups-help: Only users in these groups will be able to use any OpenAI feature. Leave blank to allow all groups.
admin.mention-restrictions-help: Override restrictions specifically for @mention responses. If left blank, the general restrictions above apply.
admin.mention-minimum-reputation-help: Minimum reputation required to @mention the ChatGPT user. Leave blank to use the general minimum reputation above.
admin.mention-allowed-groups-help: Only users in these groups will be able to @mention the ChatGPT user. Leave blank to use the general allowed groups above.
admin.pm-restrictions-help: Restrictions and API settings for users chatting privately with the ChatGPT user. If left blank, the general settings above apply.
admin.pm-api-key-help: API key to use for private chat responses. Leave blank to use the general API key. Requires a restart.
admin.pm-api-base-url-help: API base URL to use for private chat responses. Leave blank to use the general API base URL. Requires a restart.
admin.pm-minimum-reputation-help: Minimum reputation required to chat privately with the ChatGPT user. Leave blank to use the general minimum reputation above.
admin.pm-allowed-groups-help: Only users in these groups will be able to chat privately with the ChatGPT user. Leave blank to use the general allowed groups above.
admin.pm-no-permission-message-help: Message the bot sends when an unauthorized user tries to chat with it.
